headSubject: chore(ledger): WMS-9 A7 corrected verdict + menu-grouping reachability finding
summary: WMS-9 sweep: root-caused A7's real blocker via live retest -- seeded real Lote+LocalArmazenagemLote occupancy (20 units at both Origem/Destino local_armazenagems) via the concept API, re-ran the full Movimento browser save (ScrapForAI job_5eq8HQG56Byh), and it STILL fails PosicaoDentroDoMaximo with maxQuantity rendering blank in the UI. Traced to source: Movimento.itens.posicoes.maxQuantity lookupField joins OcupacaoDisponivelQuery on valueField 'disponivel', but that query (model.json:996-1002) only ever emits LocalArmazenagemLote's own fields (no 'disponivel' key) -- confirmed live via GET /api/queries/OcupacaoDisponivelQuery and in AggregateRuntime.java:607-613's buildLookupIndex. maxQuantity is null for every posicao unconditionally; a simple rename to 'quantidade' would fix Origem semantics but is wrong for Destino (needs remaining capacity, which no field in this corpus computes). Corrected WMS-9.yml verdict from BLOCKED(data) to BLOCKED(model defect, root-caused). Real seeded stock left in place for a future retest.
nextStep: Continue the WMS-9 Recebimento sweep (R15/R16/R22): drive RecebimentoWorkbench.html?id=new in the browser (data-fkey convention confirmed: h:<field> for header, s:itens:<rowId>:<field> for flat collection rows, b:itens:<rowId>:posicoes:<rowId>:<field> for nested band rows -- same generic aggregate-workbench pattern as Movimento). Create a Recebimento header (entidadeId=961034ea-28f4-4dee-be0a-ccf73137cf90, dataRecebimento today, estagio=PreRecebimento) + one RecebimentoLote row (loteId=47caecb3-9943-4c6d-b0fa-14d55e479733, quantidade=10) via Save; screenshot for R15 (Pre-Recebimento shows no allocation). Note for the record: RecebimentoWorkbench's only declared action is 'Criar Movimento' (CriarMovimentoParaRecebimentoProcedure) -- there is NO UI-wired addressing/Enderecamento button; the AlocarRecebimento flow (capability alocacao.alocarRecebimento) is a pure compute-suggestions function that never writes LocalArmazenagemLote itself, so R16 ('Enderecamento computes destination positions') has no exercisable UI path today, likely another declaration-vs-runtime gap worth recording like the menu-grouping one. R22 (stage becomes Conferido after conferencia) should be tested by editing the bare estagio text input to 'Enderecado' then 'Conferido' via generic Save and confirming the lifecycle-transition guard accepts sequential moves and rejects skips. After Recebimento, continue to Expedicao (E1/E7/E15), Inventario (I3-I7), Novo Armazem (N1/N7) per NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md Session 9 using the same ScrapForAI pattern (dot-source NPDevSamples/scripts/browser/scrapforai-harness.ps1; server already running on port 3010, key npdev-scrapforai-localkey-0001, reconstruct context object manually rather than restarting).
verified: Live REST + browser evidence, not declaration-only: Lote+2x LocalArmazenagemLote created via authenticated concept API (JWT via POST /api/auth/login); OcupacaoDisponivelQuery queried directly and shown to lack a 'disponivel' field; full Movimento draft (header+item+2 posicoes) built and saved through the real ScrapForAI browser session (job_5eq8HQG56Byh, screenshots r06_01/02/03), reproducing the PosicaoDentroDoMaximo failure with real stock present; AggregateRuntime.java:601-617 read directly to confirm the null-valueField mechanism.
